''I'' make the rules ''now''.|Cad Bane|audio=CadBaneInControl.flac|{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}}} '''Cad Bane''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] who earned a reputation as [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] best, deadliest, and most fearsome [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Though he worked for a number of clients, his loyalty was ultimately to [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]—and by extension, the highest bidder. Bane employed a variety of weapons and allies to ensure that he always got his pay, and he became the leader in his line of work after fellow [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the war. His renown attracted the attention of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and even the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the latter of whom employed him numerous times for his own means. Working for Sidious, Bane [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|stole]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to unlock the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a [[Memory crystal/Legends|repository]] of all recorded [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|infants]] in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. After [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|pilfering]] the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]] on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]] and forcing [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to unlock it, Bane was sent to kidnap four of the infants listed in the crystal. Despite being [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|captured]] halfway through his job by Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Bane [[Mission to Black Stall Station/Legends|escaped]] from Jedi Masters [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] by luring them into a trap on his hideout, [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]]. Bane was later hired by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]] to break Jabba's criminal uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], out of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] custody on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Forming a team of hunters to execute his job, Bane launched a [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|brazen raid]] on the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] and captured ten prominent [[Senator/Legends|members]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], using them as hostages to force [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine to free Ziro. Once he had secured Ziro's release from the high-security [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Central Detention Center]], Bane disbanded his posse and delivered Ziro to the Hutt Council. When Ziro escaped from their custody on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], Bane was re-hired to track down the crime lord. Though he arrived on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] too late to secure his bounty, he managed to [[Showdown on Teth/Legends|evade]] Jedi Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], who failed to apprehend him for his crimes. At the close of the bounty hunting season, Bane's total bounties surpassed those of all others in field. After breaking criminal mastermind [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] out of the Republic's Central Detention Center, Bane became a candidate in Eval's plot to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine for [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Bane thus entered Eval's [[Box/Legends|Box]] [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|competition]] to become one of the five mercenaries who would be hired for the job. After passing the tournament alongside fellow hunters [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], and [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], Bane was personally selected by Dooku to lead the operation, and they traveled to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to capture Chancellor Palpatine during the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]]. Despite Bane's success with abducting Palpatine, Dooku betrayed him, having intended for the bounty hunters' operation to simply be a diversion for his own attempt to kidnap the Supreme Chancellor. Abandoned by Dooku, Bane was defeated by Hardeen, who turned out to be none other than Obi-Wan Kenobi, who had gone undercover to infiltrate and foil Eval's plans. Bane nevertheless retained his formidable reputation throughout the Clone Wars, after which he became one of the preferred freelancers for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. ==Biography== ===Building a reputation=== {{Quote|I didn't catch your name, bounty hunter.''"
"''Bane. The name's Cad Bane.''"
"''Never heard of you.''"
"''No. No, you wouldn't have. Not yet.|The Hutt enforcer and Cad Bane|{{InsiderCite|136|Reputation (Cad Bane)}}}} The [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Cad Bane lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. He grew up on [[New Tayana]], a [[City-ship/Legends|space city]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the polluted surface of Duro. As a resident of the [[Descent Ghetto]], his best friend became fellow Duros [[Soopan]].{{TCWComicCite|6.46|Bane vs ...Bane?}} He entered [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]],{{FactFile2013|5|CAD 1-4|Cad Bane's Equipment}} beginning his career by tracking down bail jumpers and other low-level criminals in the slums of his hometown.{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-2|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 2|nolive=1}} When he eventually left New Tayana, he swore he would never return. Although he became attached to the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|financial reward]] of his missions, Bane recognized that a reputation would be necessary for success in the war-torn climate that he sensed was on the horizon, with rumors of secession abound in the Republic's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. To build a name for himself in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] community, he decided to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and thus took on a job from [[Akris Ur'etu]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]] of the [[Skar'kla Consortium]], a criminal organization based on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' [[File:NeverHeardOfYou-Insider136.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bane confronts the Jedi impostor in the wake of Akris Ur'etu's death.]] Tasked with eliminating a [[Unidentified Hutt enforcer|Jedi]] who was threatening Ur'etu's operations, Bane worked independently of the [[Gangster/Legends|gangster's]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] retinue and placed a [[portable sensor field]] on the compound's roof, which eventually alerted him to the arrival of the Jedi. As the Jedi [[Raid on the Skar'kla Consortium|broke into]] Ur'etu's compound, Bane followed from afar, noting the intruder's odd usage of several non-Jedi weapons such as a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], as well as a long-hilted [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that looked like it had been grafted onto a small [[Pike/Legends|pike]]. In addition, the Jedi appeared as though he was using small [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]] attached to his [[Limb/Legends|feet]], instead of [[Force jump/Legends|jumping]] with the aid of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] as Jedi usually did. Bane realized that he was not dealing with a Jedi, but rather an impostor using technology to mimic one. He followed the enemy agent to the Skar'kla Consortium's security center, where he saw him kill Ur'etu's [[Unidentified Weequay security chief|security chief]] and then [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choke]] the crime boss himself. Yet Bane did nothing to help Ur'etu, letting his employer die so that he could confront the false Jedi himself. Calling the agent out on his imitation of a Jedi, Bane summarily eliminated his lightsaber and then his right jetpack boot with two [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots, causing him to crash into a wall. When the false Jedi apparently used the Force to pull his blaster out of his hand, Bane recognized that the agent was using a [[monofilament cable]] with a [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] grapple and thwarted his alleged Force pull, then discovered upon inspection of the agent's wrist [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlets]] that his Force choke of Ur'etu had been nothing more than the use of a gas emitter. Speaking with the defeated agent, Bane confirmed his suspicion that the infiltrator was working as an enforcer for Ur'etu's [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] rivals, posing as a Jedi to mask his affiliations. Because he would gain no credit for killing a false Jedi, the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter decided to spare the enemy agent on the condition that he explained how to build miniaturized equipment like his, as such technology would be an incredible asset in the coming war. Basing his technology on that of the Hutt enforcer, Bane constructed a distinctive arsenal of weapons for himself, coming to rely on it in his line of work. He worked for the highest bidder,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' caring little for who employed him or the faction that his client represented, as long as he received his pay. His usual rate became quite considerable,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]'' and his allegiance to credits was so potent that if his quarry offered him a better fee, he had no qualms with turning on his original client.{{OfficialBlog|url=2009/02/28/report-from-wondercon-2009-lucasfilm-presentation-part-ii-meet-cad-bane|text=Report from WonderCon 2009: Lucasfilm Presentation (Part II: Meet Cad Bane)}}{{InsiderCite|111|Versus|Versus: Boba Fett vs. Cad Bane}} He established bases for himself in a number of locations across the galaxy, from a base of operations in the Outer Rim's [[Rogue Antar system/Legends|Rogue Antar system]] named [[Black Stall Station/Legends|Black Stall Station]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}} to a [[Cad Bane's Tatooine hideout|secret hideout]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|[[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition in-game databank}} He outfitted the former with several booby traps and a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] defense grid to stop his adversaries, countermeasures that no one was reportedly able to survive.{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a2505962439127001243b2c0158000e|text=Dataclip: Children of the Force|na=video file}} Numerous encounters with members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] furthered Bane's respect for them and their [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]], though he was not intimidated by the Force and even began to [[Jedi hunter/Legends|specialize]] in fighting Jedi[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]], DVD Featurette for "[[Hostage Crisis]]" with his trademark equipment.{{CN|url=tv_shows/starwars/?episodeID=8a250596241505e20124163d3fcd0008|text=Dataclip: Cargo of Doom|na=video file}} Bane opted to remain an independent bounty hunter rather than work through the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], an ancient institution that dominated his profession. At one point, he claimed at least three Guild-contracted bounties in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] had posted over a year prior. All of the acquisitions were as deadly as they were elusive, as one of the targets had claimed the lives of two Guild hunters before Bane successfully hunted down the target. Although Bane had kept a low profile while dealing with the Hutts, he attracted the attention of the Guild's leader, [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]], who was outraged that an independent hunter had claimed bounties promised to the Guild. Seeking to put a stop to Bane's interference with Guild contracts, Cradossk arranged a meeting with Bane on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. There, Cradossk attempted to trap and kill Bane, who outmaneuvered his rival but chose not to murder him for alleged professional reasons. However, according to Cradossk's own account of the incident in his autobiography ''[[Making a Killing]]'', the two met on more cordial terms, merely agreeing to stay out of each other's way.''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'' ===The Clone Wars=== ====Wartime fame==== {{Quote|Master Cad Bane, I presume. I've heard ''much'' about you. Who hasn't? The greatest hunter since Jango lost his head…|Davtokk|''[[The Clone Wars: Invitation Only]]''}} [[File:CadBane-BlasterToting.png|thumb|right|230px|Bane built a considerable reputation for himself by the time of the Clone Wars.]] As he gained prominence over the next few years, Bane earned notoriety{{HBCite|291}} and a reputation as the galaxy's preeminent [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]. He became known as one of the most notorious, ruthless, and fearsome bounty hunters,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090317.html|text=The Chilling Season Finale Introduces a Deadly New Enemy}} particularly after the death of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]—the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bounty hunter considered to be the galaxy's best—at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|opening battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].{{Film|II}} With Fett out of the picture, Bane's reputation grew as the war continued between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. He worked with several underworld dregs in his jobs; among their number was the [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifting]] [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Cato Parasitti/Legends|Cato Parasitti]], a lethal [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who shared his allegiance to credits. Parasitti subcontracted assignments for him and recruited extra help as he required.{{DB|character|catoparasitti|Parasitti, Cato}} During the war, Bane [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] the ''[[Sleight of Hand]]'', a [[Telgorn dropship]] that he extensively modified; he used the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] many a time to disable [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] cargo ships.''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 2: Curse of the Black Hole Pirates]]'' His work earned him some powerful enemies, and a 500,000-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bounty was placed on his head for crimes against the Republic.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090928poster/index.html|text=Cad Bane Wanted Poster}} Bane was captured at least once by the Republic and was incarcerated in the high-level [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on Coruscant, which was staffed by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]]. After discovering that [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] security was particularly poor in the facility's cremation center, Bane learned to escape through the crematorium via the morgue, obtaining and memorizing the code for the morgue's door. From the crematorium, he found easy access to the prison's lower landing platforms, which opened out onto the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]].{{TCW|Deception}} Some came to wonder if Bane had allowed himself to be captured on purpose so as to devise a way to escape from the prison.{{FactFile2014|12|BAN 1-4|Cad Bane}} From his numerous exploits, Bane attracted the attention of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], whom he worked for during the war.{{CSWECite|I|57|Bane, Cad}} At some point, Bane had a run-in with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]], who swore to get even with him following the incident.{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}} On another occasion, Bane formed a temporary alliance with a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang to advance his own interests. Once his business with the pirates was finished, he took one of the group's [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bikes]] as part of his payment.{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=Pirate Speeder Bike with Cad Bane|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCWDLXPirateBike-CadBane.asp}} ====Manipulations on Kynachi==== {{Quote|I found this while I was searching for my own quarry. I suspect it may have belonged to the Jedi you sought.''"
"''Was there no other sign of him?''"
"''Only the lightsaber. For what it's worth, I hope you find him.''"
"''Thank you. What'd you say your name was?''"
"''I didn't.|Cad Bane gains the trust of Nuru Kungurama by returning Ring-Sol Ambase's lightsaber to him|}} [[File:NuruKungurama-SA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bane was able to gain Nuru Kungurama's trust on Kynachi.]] In 22 BBY, the first year of the war, Bane was residing in a shabby [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] room on Coruscant when [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious contacted him through his compact [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] for a job. In what was to grow into an increasingly complex scheme, Bane was contracted to pursue Jedi Master [[Ring-Sol Ambase]], who was embarking on a [[Mission to Kynachi|mission]] to the planet [[Kynachi]] with his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Nuru Kungurama]], and a clone trooper [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Though he raised his fee due to the involvement of a Jedi, Bane accepted the assignment and immediately left for Kynachi. After bypassing the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the planet and arriving on the Federation-controlled world, Bane hired the local [[Gunn's Diner|diner]] owner [[Lalo Gunn]] to befriend and stick close to Kungurama and his squad's clone troopers,''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]'' who had all been stranded on Kynachi following [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] to their ship. He also recruited a [[Unidentified food vendor|food vendor]] to identify any strangers in a [[City/Legends|town]] on the planet, hoping to track Kungurama's progress. He provided the vendor with a special comlink that overrode the Federation's [[frequency jammer]], which had been disrupting communications on the planet for [[32 BBY/Legends|over a decade]]. While staying at a hotel on Kynachi, Bane was contacted by the food vendor, who reported that Kungurama and the three of his squad's clone troopers were headed with Gunn to her diner. Complying with Sidious's latest instructions, Bane proceeded to the diner and staged an elaborate deception in order to manipulate the group's actions, summoning four [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] to fake a fight with him at Gunn's [[YT-1760 small transport/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Hasty Harpy]]''. After the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] attacked Kungurama and the clones and were destroyed by the Republic squad, Bane pretended that a [[luma grenade]] had blinded him, and troopers [[Chatterbox]] and [[Knuckles (182nd Legion)|Knuckles]] found him lying on the ground in front of the diner. The clones brought Bane into the building, where Kungurama, Dunn, and trooper [[Breaker (Breakout Squad)|Breaker]], questioned him on his identity and business. Taking the risk of revealing to the trio that he was a bounty hunter in order to more effectively deceive them, Bane lied and stated that the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] had been trying to arrest him and had opened fire on him when he had tried to run away. When Gunn questioned why he was on Kynachi, Bane flatly replied that a job had brought him there, but the unsatisfied Gunn put one of the fallen droids' [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]] to his forehead and demanded to know how he had bypassed the Trade Federation's blockade. Bane stated that he had been hired to break someone out of the [[KynachTech Industries]] [[KynachTech factory prison|factory prison]] and that his client had provided him with a [[Data-tape/Legends|datatape]] of the [[KynachTech factory|facility's]] schematics and pass codes to get through the Federation blockade. His disclosures earned him freedom from the blaster on his forehead. However, Bane truthfully reported that earlier he had seen the factory's droid guards escorting into the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] four Republic troopers and an unconscious Ring-Sol Ambase—the latter of whom, unbeknownst to the others, Bane had been hired to capture alive. With the scenario that Bane had provided, Kungurama, determined to rescue his Master, developed a plan to have Breaker build a new droid—using parts from the disabled droid commandos and the [[Genetech Corporation|Genetech]] [[Droid brain/Legends|brain]] of Gunn's [[2JTJ personal navigation droid|assistant droid]], [[Cleaver|Teejay]], who had been destroyed in the droid ambush—to break into the prison. That idea was, in fact, the exact plan that Bane had intended for Kungurama to devise. Bane accompanied Chatterbox, Knuckles, and Gunn as they reconnoitered the prison, and he then took them to the Kynachi [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] [[Docking Bay 21 (Kynachi)|Docking Bay 21]] to check out his ship, the ''Sleight of Hand,'' which the group planned to use to escape from the planet once they had rescued the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from the KynachTech prison. The four then returned to Gunn's [[Transport/Legends|transport]], where Breaker and Kungurama were assembling the new droid. The unit was successfully reactivated and was renamed "Cleaver." Bane proposed a risky plan to break into the prison and liberate the captives, and the group proceeded to put the stratagem into motion. With Kungurama, Gunn, the troopers, and a [[Poncho/Legends|poncho]]-adorned Bane posing as prisoners and Cleaver acting as their droid captor, they were admitted into the facility. Upon entering the prison, the members of the squad dropped their disguises and confronted the facility's [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Overseer/Legends|overseer]], [[Umbrag]]. As Kungurama cornered Umbrag and demanded information from him, the Overseer inadvertently caused a battle droid to fire its [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. At the sound of blaster fire, Bane drew his [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistols]] and began to shoot at the nearest battle droids, sparking a chaotic [[Lightfight|firefight]]. [[File:MissionToKynachi-SA.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Bane was able to capture Ambase with Breakout Squad distracted at the prison.]] With the others' attention focused on the battle, Bane was able to slip away and capture Ring-Sol Ambase, who had been taken prisoner by battle droids. Bane placed the comatose Ambase in a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] [[stasis pod]] to keep him in his near-death condition. Bane later returned to the prison with Ambase's lightsaber and found Kungurama, Gunn, and the troopers, who had driven Umbrag away and had been reunited with the rest of their clone squad. Bane continued to deceive the group, stating that he had been unsuccessful in finding his previous quarry. Despite lacking the clones' trust, Bane gave Ambase's lightsaber to Kungurama with the lie that it was all he had found of Ambase; he received Kungurama's thanks before departing, though he refused to give the Padawan his name. Bane used a [[Hoversled/Legends|hoversled]] taken from the KynachTech factory to transport Ambase's stasis pod and returned to the ''Sleight of Hand'' in Docking Bay 21, bringing Ambase's body onto the vessel. Departing from the planet, Bane used his pass codes to bypass several [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] that had arrived in orbit of the world. After activating his ship's [[Autopilot/Legends|autopilot]] mode, Bane returned to the main cabin and contacted Sidious, to whom he reported his success. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] was pleased with the result and told Bane to deliver Ambase to [[Bogg 5]], the fifth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Bogden system/Legends|Bogden system]]. During the ''Sleight of Hand''{{'s}} [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] trip to Bogg 5, Bane passed the [[Time/Legends|time]] by watching ''[[The Bounty Hunters' Guild's Greatest Hits: Volume VII]]'', a [[Holovid/Legends|collection]] of [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorded]] assassinations compiled by the Bounty Hunters' Guild that featured the Guild's leader, Cradossk, and his son, [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. Bane also corrected a fluctuation in the Telgorn [[Dropship/Legends|dropship's]] [[Null quantum field generator/Legends|null quantum field generator]] and kept watch on Ambase's vital signs. When the ''Sleight of Hand'' exited hyperspace near the planet [[Bogden/Legends|Bogden]], Bane piloted his ship to the starship traffic–heavy Bogg 5 and obtained his landing coordinates from a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] in orbit of the moon. Although his designated landing area on Bogg 5—an unpopulated spot north of [[Mong'tar City]]—was empty save for a waiting [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]], he spent the next two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] circling the vicinity to ensure that he was not being followed. Once he had confirmed as much, Bane touched down near the [[Solar sailer/Legends|solar sailer]] and met with the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], an agent of Sidious's associate, the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku. After showing Ventress how to operate Ambase's stasis pod, the monitor of which frequently built up with [[Water/Legends|ice]] that required an [[Ice pick/Legends|ice pick]] to break, Bane handed the inert Ambase over to her. He then received Sidious's next assignment from her and left for the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] to execute the job.''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]'' He also sent a transmission to Gunn, promising to pay her more credits to ensure that Kungurama and the clone troopers of [[Breakout Squad]], as they had become known, reached the planet [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]], a task that she accepted. I shall contact you when I next require your services.|Cad Bane and Darth Sidious|}} [[File:LaloGunn-BHPCover.jpg|thumb|left|Bane hired Lalo Gunn to manipulate Breakout Squad.]] On his next assignment for Sidious, Bane set out to secure [[Bilbringi Depot]], the primary settlement of the system's largest [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], [[Bilbringi VII]]. He brought an old [[Leather/Legends|leather]] satchel with one thousand [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]] from Sidious to buy the depot from its owner, [[Drixo]] the Hutt, but he also took along three deadly [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]] in case Drixo refused to sell her property. Arriving at Bilbringi Depot, Bane was stopped by two [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards at the entrance to Drixo's headquarters, and he used chips of precious metal to bribe them into admitting him to the compound. When the Gamorreans demanded more, Bane simply killed them with his silencer-capped blasters, retrieved his metal offerings, and admitted himself to the depot, with his IG-86 sentinel droids secretly following behind. Proceeding to Drixo's chamber, Bane was intercepted by several of her bodyguards, and a pair of [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] guards stripped him of his blasters while a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] guard took the peggat satchel. Speaking with Drixo from the chamber overlooking her pit, Bane conveyed his client's offer to buy Bilbringi Depot for the one thousand peggats. Although Drixo dismissed the bid, she also refused to return the peggats, an action that displeased Bane. With Drixo remaining uncooperative, Bane resorted to his backup plan and had his IG-86 sentinel droids enter the room and open fire on everyone there. In the ensuing chaos of blaster fire, he retrieved his blasters from the Klatooinians and promptly killed them too. With all of Drixo's guards dead, Bane dispatched the two [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] servants that were down with her in the pit. Though Drixo begged for her life and offered to give Bilbringi Depot to him for free, Bane simply had his droids eliminate her, claiming the depot by force. Leaving no evidence of his work, Bane reported to Sidious the successful capture of Bilbringi Depot, and a pleased Sidious transferred payment to his account. Bilbringi Depot was meanwhile used to further manipulate Breakout Squad. Bane next traveled to [[Vaced Spaceport]] on Vaced to meet with Lalo Gunn, who had covertly ensured that Breakout Squad had reached there. However, the job had cost Gunn the ''Hasty Harpy'', and she had subsequently been stranded on Vaced. Finding Gunn in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] at the spaceport, Bane assured the cross Gunn that she would be well paid for her exploits. As night fell on Vaced, Bane and Gunn waited at the cantina for the bounty hunter [[Doxun Feez]] to bring Gunn's payment. While they waited, Gunn attempted to make sense of the "coincidences" surrounding Breakout Squad, many of which had been orchestrated by Bane in line with Sidious's plans for Kungurama. Bane nevertheless remained tight-lipped when responding to Gunn's observations, though Guun thought that he seemed surprised to learn that a saboteur on the ''Hasty Harpy'' had been responsible for Breakout Squad's detour to the Black Hole sector. Eventually, Robonino showed up with Gunn's pay instead of Feez, who had joined the Black Hole Pirates. Discussion between Gunn and Robonino further revealed that the latter had subcontracted the bounty hunter Bossk, whose capability Bane severely doubted, as "backup" for the infiltration of the Black Hole Pirates. After giving Gunn the pouch of [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chips]] that Robonino had brought, Bane left the cantina to have a brief word in private with Robonino outside. Besides not being pleased to learn that Doxun Feez had failed to bring Gunn's payment, Bane was further irked that Robonino had subcontracted Bossk for the job involving the Black Hole Pirates. Just as he was lecturing Robonino on subcontracting, Bane noticed a small [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] on his comrade's shoulder and realized that Gunn, looking to eavesdrop on their conversation after Bane's withholding of information, had secretly placed it there. After alerting Robonino to the device, Bane immediately strode back into the cantina to confront Gunn, who had anticipated and evaded him by hiding in the tavern's storeroom. Failing to find Gunn, Bane returned outside and crushed the transmitter, but an incoming transmission on his [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] stopped him from pursuing Gunn. Taking the message privately, Bane was hired by Sidious for an assignment that required him to leave Vaced immediately. He was surprised to learn that it again involved Ring-Sol Ambase, who had escaped from Bogg 5 with the clone trooper [[Sharp (clone trooper)|Sharp]]. Sharp had been previously captured on Kynachi by Asajj Ventress as Bane had captured Ambase, who—under the impression that he could not trust his fellow Jedi—was now headed with Sharp for Coruscant, where he intended to secure an exotic [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] that was currently under study by the Jedi Order. Sidious thus hired Bane to help Ambase retrieve the escape pod. [[File:NuruVsAmbase-Missions4.jpg|thumb|right|230px|Bane paved the way for Kungurama to duel his own Master, Ring-Sol Ambase.]] Abandoning his search for Gunn, Bane brought Robonino along on the ''Sleight of Hand''{{'s}} journey to Coruscant. There, they located Ambase, who was traveling with Sharp aboard a [[Corona-class transport|''Corona''-class transport]] to [[Moxonnic Manufacturing]], an abandoned establishment in the [[Dacho District]] that had been converted to house the Jedi's [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] for examining the Chiss escape pod. Heading for Coruscant's night side, Bane landed the ''Sleight of Hand'' on the rooftop where Ambase and Sharp had landed, and he went with Robonino to meet them. Speaking with Ambase, Bane told the Jedi Master that he had been hired to help him retrieve the escape pod, having been provided by Sidious with the access codes and equipment to bypass the laboratory's security systems. Bane also provided Ambase and Sharp with Republic Navy officers' uniforms to gain access to the lab building from the guards stationed inside. Though Ambase, whom Dooku had manipulated, was skeptical of Bane, he conceded that they were wasting time and followed the bounty hunter's plan. Entering the lab, Bane, Ambase, Sharp, and Robonino bypassed both automated and guard security, with Robonino sealing the checkpoint door behind them with a [[Magna lock/Legends|magna lock]]. Along the way to the room housing the escape pod, Bane shot down three [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droids]] that Sidious had not made him aware of, while Robonino was forced to use thermal detonators to open the door to the room. Once inside the main laboratory room, Bane powered up the ''Sleight of Hand'' from his gauntlets while Robonino planted explosives on the far wall, so that Bane could use his Telgorn dropship's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to remove the escape pod from the lab. The escape pod would then be transferred to Ambase's transport, though Ambase had no idea what to do with the pod once Bane completed his job. With everything in place, Robonino blew apart the westward wall, allowing Bane to remotely guide the ''Sleight of Hand'' through the hole to lock onto the Chiss spacecraft. After Ambase had unlocked the Jedi energy lock keeping the pod secured to the ground, Bane climbed into his dropship and locked onto the pod with the tractor beam. Robonino, Ambase, and Sharp then joined him aboard the ship, which Bane piloted out of the laboratory, heading for the building's roof. There, Bane and Robonino helped Ambase and Sharp load the Chiss spacecraft onto their ''Corona''-class transport. As soon as they had finished, Bane heard the whine of an approaching starship's [[Engine/Legends|engine]] and sighted an incoming [[TL-1800 transport|TL-1800 freighter]], which in fact contained Kungurama and Breakout Squad, who intended to prevent Ambase from stealing the escape pod. Before Kungurama could land, Bane immediately boarded the ''Sleight of Hand'' with Robonino, firing a missile at Kungurama's freighter before departing from the vicinity. Focused on Ambase, Kungurama believed that Ambase had been responsible for the missile, and a [[Skirmish at Moxonnic Manufacturing|duel]] between the two erupted as soon as Bane had left, as Darth Sidious had planned. ====Theft from Kul Teska==== {{Quote|Bane? Ha, ha, ha. Forgive my surprise. I didn't think even ''you'' were foolish enough to steal from me.''"
"''Pity you didn't go down with the ship, Teska.|Kul Teska and Cad Bane exchange pleasantries on Ryloth|audio=TeskaBane.flac|''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''}} [[File:Cad_Bane_TCWRH.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane wields his blaster pistols on Ryloth.]] Later that year, using the ''Sleight of Hand'', Bane hijacked one of the two [[Gravitic Core]]s of the [[gravitic polarization beam]] weapon manufactured by the Separatist [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Kul Teska]]—a "competitor" of his—over the ice world [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. After stealing one crate containing the Core, Bane detonated the other Core to cover his escape from Teska's [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], leaving it to be hit by the ensuing explosion. He took the ''Sleight of Hand'' to the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], which the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] had recently [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|liberated]] from the Confederacy. In the city of [[Resdin]], Bane captured [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] and [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Boomer (Advanced Recon Force trooper)|CS-2207]]—nicknamed "Rex" and "Boomer," respectively—to assist him in his exploits. Bringing Rex and Boomer to a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] and placing them in [[Bomb/Legends|explosive]]-wired [[Binders/Legends|binders]], Bane forced the clones to comply with his demands. As Separatist battle droids broke into the hangar, Rex and Boomer agreed to defend Bane's crate and take the cargo to his ship elsewhere on the planet. With the pair's promised cooperation, the bounty hunter released the links on the pair's handcuffs, allowing them to operate freely. Bane and his new accomplices defeated the attacking lines of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]]. Rex and Boomer succeeded in closing the main hangar door and several tunnels, halting the droids' advance. When a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighter]] broke through the main entrance and opened fire on the group, Bane offered some heavy [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] to the clones, and they used it to destroy the droid. Shortly thereafter, Separatist reinforcements appeared in the form of B1, B2, and [[Sabotage droid/Legends|sabotage droid]]s, but with the arrival of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his Padawan, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]—who had come to rescue the clones and grudgingly decided to assist the bounty hunter—Bane, Rex, and Boomer were able to defeat the droids. After the group had taken down a large [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra magna tri-droid]],''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' Bane directed his blaster fire at the Jedi and clones. Skywalker rebounded the laser shots, causing the bounty hunter to lose his balance atop a platform and tumble to the ground; the Jedi then held Bane at lightsaber point. The bounty hunter's bargaining chips were rendered defunct when Skywalker severed the clones' binders. Rex and Boomer then disarmed Bane, though he kept an extra [[Blaster pistol/Legends|pistol]] hidden elsewhere. As explosions went off outside, Bane proposed the ''Sleight of Hand'' as a means of escape. With no other options, Skywalker took Bane up on his offer and sent Rex and Boomer to provide covering fire from an elevated position. Though unaware of the crate's contents, Skywalker and Tano were unwilling to let it fall into Separatist hands and forced Bane to carry the Core to his ship. En route to the Telgorn dropship, Skywalker, Tano, and Bane encountered numerous B1, B2, [[Chameleon droid/Legends|chameleon droids]], and [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]], but the Jedi were able to defeat all of them. Along the way to the ''Sleight of Hand'', Bane frequently grew tired from carrying the heavy weight of the [[Gravity/Legends|Gravitic]] Core and stopped several times to rest behind larger crates scattered around the landscape, relying on the Jedi and clones to protect him from the enemy droids' fire. When the path was blocked by starship wreckage, Rex fired a [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] at the rubble, and the Jedi and Bane climbed the debris. Skywalker and Tano jumped across a gap in their path and used the Force to collapse a [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] wing, enabling Bane to cross the divide with the Gravitic Core. When Skywalker, Tano, and Bane took a cliff-side path, they gradually moved beyond the clones' range and were forced to cope without their covering fire. After Skywalker and Tano had eliminated a thicket of B1, [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1]], sabotage, and destroyer droids in addition to a squad of [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]], Bane followed the pair to the ground and across a destroyed [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|droid tank]] to an adjacent ridge. Arriving at the ''Sleight of Hand'', Bane set his crate down and slowly retrieved his alternate pistol as Skywalker conferred with his Padawan. At that moment, some of the wreckage surrounding the dropship exploded. Although Skywalker and Tano were occupied with holding the debris in the air with the Force and were open targets for the bounty hunter, Bane's firing hand was hit by a piece of wreckage before he could take advantage of the Jedi's distraction and fire at them. [[File:SleightOfHand-TCWRH.png|thumb|right|230px|Bane's dropship, the ''Sleight of Hand'']] Teska himself blasted out of the wreckage and confronted the three, demanding that Bane hand over the Gravitic Core. Teska used a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] to seize the crate, but Skywalker intervened and Force-pushed the device into Bane's ship. Before Bane could board the ''Sleight of Hand'' and escape with the crate, Tano trapped him under a slab of metal. As the Jedi and Teska engaged each other in a duel, Bane sneaked away and made his own escape from Ryloth. Although Teska fled with the Core and stole the ''Sleight of Hand'', Bane later intervened in the Republic's [[Battle of Behpour|siege]] of Teska's [[Behpour facility|facility]] on the planet [[Behpour/Legends|Behpour]]. While Teska's gravitic beam powered up to attack the [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo sun]], Bane exacted his revenge on the scientist by firing at Teska's rocket boosters during the scientist's fight with Skywalker and Tano in the weapon's core room, stranding Teska on the central platform.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes'': Prima Official Game Guide]] Leaving Teska to be defeated by Skywalker and Tano, Bane retrieved his Telgorn dropship and escaped from Behpour. Following that incident, Bane sabotaged the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] that Count Dooku and Asajj Ventress were using to flee from Behpour; the mercenary watched the pair's [[Shuttle/Legends|vessel]] malfunction in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] from the ''Sleight of Hand'' before rocketing away. While Bane was on Duro, a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] sought him out, looking for information on Asajj Ventress. Bane suggested—correctly—that Ventress was after a bounty on a [[Senator/Legends|senator]], and the Jedi Knight was able to thus able to prevent Ventress from kidnapping Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. It was not long, however, before Bane was fighting the very same Jedi Knight. When the Hutt crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] hired Bane to deal with an [[Skirmish on the Dune Sea|ongoing conflict]] between the Jedi and a [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|pirate gang]] in Tatooine's [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], the Jedi Knight became Bane's target. Eventually, Count Dooku hired Bane to spread a clone trooper virus at the Republic's [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]]. During the course of that gambit, Bane was captured and incarcerated in a Republic detention center, but he approached the Jedi Knight he had dealt with earlier, offering to make a deal while instead intending to escape from the prison. Bane was able to break out of the facility using a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], and he also freed fellow prisoner [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], a Hutt crime lord. The pair escaped from the prison aboard a ''Munificent''-class star [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], and after dropping Ziro off on Tatooine, Bane headed to meet with the pirate leader [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] on the planet [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Bane next went to see the Confederate [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Mar Tuuk/Legends|Mar Tuuk]] before proceeding to the Kaliida Shoals [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]], where he infected the clone trooper healing tanks with Dooku's virus so that it would spread amongst the Republic Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]].{{TCWA|Card Commander}} Despite his efforts, Bane was defeated, and a team of [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healers]] was sent to stop the spread of the virus. Bane then headed to the [[Third moon of Vassek/Legends|third moon]] of the planet [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek]], where the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] maintained a [[Grievous's castle/Legends|stronghold]]. There, the pursuant Jedi Knight [[Duel at Grievous's castle|battled]] Grievous and Count Dooku before confronting Bane himself in a final showdown. Ziro, meanwhile, was reinstalled in the Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center, though he was not to stay there for the remainder of the war.{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode022.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hostage Crisis}} ===Work for Darth Sidious=== ====Stealing a Jedi holocron==== {{Quote|To get a holocron, I'd have to break into the Jedi Temple. It's impossible, not to mention deadly.''"
"''Perhaps your reputation has been ''exaggerated''.''"

"''You've got a deal.|Cad Bane and Darth Sidious|audio=YouveGotADeal-HH.flac|{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}}} [[File:Sidious_hiring_Bane.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane is hired by Darth Sidious for the gambit.]] In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],{{TCWdates|201}} Bane was hired by Darth Sidious for another ruse, but he first had to first prove his skills to Sidious in a [[Mission to Coruscant (Cad Bane)|mission]] to the heart of the Republic: the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. Blasting his way through the Senate security, which consisted of clone troopers and [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]], Bane uncovered the location of [[Ord Enisence/Legends|Ord Enisence]], a Jedi Master whom Darth Sidious wanted eliminated{{SWArchive|url=games/playnow/jedi_hunter/index.html|text=Cad Bane: Jedi Hunter|int=Cad Bane: Jedi Hunter}} and who was away from Coruscant, fighting against the Separatists. After killing Enisence,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' Bane collected the million-credit bounty that the Separatists had posted on Jedi. He moved Enisence's body to his apartment in a seedy [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] hotel,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}} where Sidious personally contacted him with his real mission: stealing a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Archives]]. Sidious required the holocron to access the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a [[Memory crystal/Legends|repository]] of all [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in the galaxy that was under the protection of Jedi Master [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]]; the Sith Lord also employed Bane to purloin the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. Bane initially believed infiltrating the Temple to be impossible, but when Sidious put his reputation into question, Bane agreed to the assignment regardless of its costs, albeit with the request for an elite [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|''Rogue''-class starfighter]] and triple his usual rate. Sidious agreed to meet those terms and also provided the schematics of the Temple. In preparation for the operation, Bane subcontracted Cato Parasitti for assistance and prepared his [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]], [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]], for the job. As Bane worked on Todo in his apartment, he lied to his droid that he was only doing some maintenance, while in actuality he was installing an explosive in the droid. Bane had Todo let Parasitti into the apartment when she arrived, and the two bounty hunters examined Sidious's intelligence file on Ropal. Though Parasitti questioned whether they were going after him, Bane replied that they soon would but brought her attention to their current assignment—stealing a holocron from the Jedi Temple. Despite Sidious's inside information, Bane still required help beyond what Todo could provide—an agent on the inside of the Temple. To that end, Bane pointed Parasitti to Enisence's body, whose form the Clawdite easily assumed to pose as the dead Jedi. Bane passed an [[Earbud comlink/Legends|ear-comlink]] to Parasitti so that they could maintain contact, and although Parasitti questioned the details of Bane's own plan to break into the [[Holocron Vault/Legends|Holocron Vaults]], Bane kept a calm demeanor and stated that he would handle it. With that, the bounty hunters proceeded to the Jedi Temple and set their [[Raid on the Jedi Temple/Legends|plan]] into motion. Bane and Todo used their [[Rocket boot/Legends|rocket boots]] to reach an unattended overhang on the side of the Jedi Temple, close to the building's roof. With Parasitti at a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminal in the Archive Library, Todo was able to locate a weak point in the Temple's [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy shield]] and opened up an aperture in the shield with a touch of his finger. Bane and his droid zoomed in through the breach and entered a ventilation shaft, where they descended into a wide, vertical passage that was being blocked by a set of large, active fans. Parasitti directed Todo to the control board, and the droid deactivated the fans so that he and Bane could slip between their blades. Once Bane and Todo had passed between the blades of one of the fans, the droid accidentally reactivated the fan from a motion-sensing security switch. Before the blades could slice the two, Parasitti disabled the fan, saving both of them. With the way clear, the pair continued on through the vent system to a shaft directly overlooking the high-security Holocron Vaults, which was being protected by a dense laser web. Although Todo wanted to bypass the grate, Bane stopped him and checked with Parasitti on the vault's security measures. Bane noted a change in his comrade's voice, as the shapeshifting Parasitti had assumed the form of [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi librarian]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]]. Hearing the sounds of the Jedi searching for them, Bane impatiently waited as Parasitti deactivated the vault's laser [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] system from her terminal. The instant that the primary laser systems were down, Bane and Todo descended into the shaft leading to the Holocron Vaults. While Bane used his gauntlet to cut through the safe's lock mechanism, Todo deactivated the remainder of the laser beams surrounding the vault's entrance. [[File:BaneHolocronChamber-HH.png|thumb|right|250px|Bane enters the Holocron Vaults with the Jedi distracted by Parasitti and Todo 360.]] Bane directed Todo to slice through the wall and cut a passage to the Temple's [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|communication center]] in order to have his techno-service droid lure the Jedi away from the vault, although the bounty hunter hid his intentions—and the fact that he had implanted a bomb in the droid—from Todo. Parasitti, meanwhile, was captured by Ahsoka Tano and revealed Bane's objective to the Jedi. Losing contact with his inside agent, Bane was unable to access the diagrams that would help him deactivate the lock. He barked at Todo to go to the Jedi Temple's communication center to pose as a distraction for the Jedi, and once the droid departed, Bane primed a bomb of the same model that he had installed in his droid to break through the vault's lock. The hunter hid from the approaching Jedi—Anakin Skywalker and Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who had learned of the mercenary's target from Tano—as the explosive went off and waited until the pair had followed Todo to the communication center before emerging from the shadows. Bane heaved the Holocron Vaults' door open all the way and proceeded unopposed into the room, where he extracted the holocron from its holding place. He then stuffed the holocron into a pocket and donned a [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robe]] to sneak away through the Archive Library, slipping out in broad daylight in a display of his sheer nerve. Despite catching sight of a cuffed Parasitti being led away by Tano and the real Jocasta Nu, Bane did not attempt to rescue her and ducked his head, heading away in the other direction. Bane escaped the Temple without either of his accomplices, leaving Parasitti in the Jedi's custody and allowing Todo to serve his purpose as a decoy by being destroyed by the explosive that he had installed in the droid earlier. ====Exploits at Devaron==== {{Quote|You have nowhere left to run, bounty hunter.''"

Sing reported that she was on the western end of the valley where the outpost was located, but even though she spotted Ropal and had a clear shot at him, Bane ordered her not to shoot the Jedi Master, as he was his target. Instead, Bane told Sing to distract Ropal's Padawan, [[Tyzen Xebec]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}} and several clones who had just arrived. In the meantime, Bane left his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] and moved in to capture Ropal. En route to the surface in a ''Rogue''-class starfighter, Bane shot several clone troopers before landing and heading for Ropal's position. Along the way, Bane received word from his command ship's crew that the Republic [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] had arrived out of hyperspace and realized that Parasitti had betrayed his target to the Jedi, at which he swore to return the favor. Bane ordered his armada of frigates into defensive formation to stop the ''Resolute'' before it could interrupt his task. He found Ropal deflecting blaster shots with his lightsaber and loaded an expensive shot of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] into his blaster pistol, using it to short out Ropal's weapon. [[File:Bane_tortures_Ropal.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane tortures Ropal aboard his frigate to get him to open the holocron.]] With Ropal disarmed, Bane threw a cord at the Jedi Master, tying his legs together and knocking him to the ground. Although Ropal tossed his temporarily defunct lightsaber aside and refused to open the holocron for him, Bane had one of his super battle droids shock Ropal, rendering him unconscious. Bane took Ropal hostage and stole the Kyber crystal from his person before loading him on board a ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle and taking him to his command ship. As Bane rendezvoused with a Trade Federation escort of ''Munificent''-class frigates over Devaron that [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] had provided at Darth Sidious's request, they were ambushed by the ''Resolute'', commanded by Skywalker. Ordering his battle droid crew to move the ship out of the battle zone and prepare to jump to hyperspace, Bane went to confront Ropal in the Jedi's holding cell, as only a Jedi could open the holocron and combine it with the Kyber crystal to make it readable. However, the ''Resolute'' targeted the frigate's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and compromised the ship's [[Power converter/Legends|power converters]], trapping Bane in the [[Devaron system/Legends|system]]. Bane was notified of that impediment on his way to Ropal's cell by a battle droid, and wondered out loud what the Jedi were planning. Though Bane [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] Ropal with electrical charges, the Jedi Master continued to refuse to unlock the crystal with the holocron. Having no use for an uncooperative prisoner, Bane ordered his [[Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Cad Bane's frigate)/Legends|droid subordinate]] to increase Ropal's electrocution to full power, killing the Jedi Master. Bane saw the murder as only a slight setback to achieving his objective,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode202.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Cargo of Doom}} but he still required a Jedi to access the crystal. Returning to his ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], Bane was contacted by an upset Gunray, who was angered that four of his loaned ships had been destroyed. Bane remained unconcerned about the losses; he knew that Sidious valued the information in the memory crystal and believed that the Sith Lord would compensate Gunray's expenses. As Skywalker and Tano landed on the dorsal [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of Bane's frigate with [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]], Bane refused to send out Vulture droid reinforcements into the battle—to the surprise of both his battle droid crew and Gunray. Although Gunray demanded that he transmit the information and abandon the plan before the Jedi boarded his ship and stole the holocron back, Bane replied that he could not submit the data, but still intended to let Skywalker and Tano embark his ship in order to get one of them to unlock the crystal with the holocron. Ending his conversation with Gunray, Bane gave orders to his crew, telling them to wipe the frigate's memory, activate the [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct sequence]], and transfer control of all shipboard functions to his wrist-com. Leaving his battle droids to defend the bridge, Bane escaped through a ventilation duct moments before Skywalker, Tano, Clone Captain Rex, and their clone trooper squad arrived there and captured it from the droids. On the frigate's [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] deck, Bane assembled lines of B1 and B2 battle droids, intending to have them fight and distract the clones while he himself separated the Jedi and led one of them away. With his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in place, Bane ran through the hallways of his frigate and lured the Jedi and clones—who had found the late Ropal in his holding cell—to the gunnery deck. Once Skywalker, Tano, and the clones had arrived in the darkened room, Bane revealed his forces by reactivating the lights and ordered the droids to open fire on the Jedi and clones. As a gunfight erupted as planned, Bane secured himself to the floor with his [[magno-grip boot]]s and increased the fight's stakes by disabling the frigate's [[Gravity generator/Legends|gravity generators]] and deactivating the artificial gravity. The Jedi and clones rose off the floor, while the battle droids, still magnetized to the deck, continued to fire at them. Bane targeted his blaster fire at Skywalker, who made it past him, and the bounty hunter quickly got out of range of the Jedi's lightsaber slashes. Bane opened fire on the clones, shooting and killing several of them. However, Skywalker soon returned to fight Bane, surprising him from behind and delivering a kick that knocked the holocron out of his grip. Just as Skywalker was about to grab the holocron, the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] reactivated the gravity, plummeting everyone back down to the floor. [[File:BaneTorturesAhsoka.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bane electrocutes Tano in order to take her hostage.]] Bane retrieved the holocron and shot at a trooper still magnetized to the roof, keeping Skywalker occupied with safely lowering the clone to the floor while he himself made his escape. Bane drew Tano after him, and the Padawan fell into his trap. Luring Tano into a dead-end corridor away from Skywalker, Bane cut her off from her Master by closing the hallway's [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] behind her. Bane's first laser shot at the Padawan was deflected back at one of his gauntlets, but he managed to deliver a kick that knocked [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|her lightsaber]] out of her hand. Before he could fire at her again, Tano brazenly grabbed his blaster arm and flipped him to the ground. Bane stopped Tano from telekinetically retrieving her lightsaber by grabbing her ankle and sending a paralyzing [[stun charge]] through her body that knocked her unconscious. He picked up the holocron and placed Tano in self-tightening [[Stun/Legends|stun]] cuffs that had been specially designed for Jedi. Once Tano had woken up, Bane stole her [[Padawan braid/Legends|Padawan braid]] jewelry from her as a trophy. As the two exchanged banter, Bane electrocuted Tano to increase Skywalker's sense of urgency. He then moved the subdued Tano to the frigate's [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] and placed her on the space-ward side of the shield. After receiving word from a battle droid outside the airlock that Skywalker had arrived, Bane activated the airlock's shield, trapping Tano so that she could serve as a bargaining chip. Skywalker entered the room to find Tano at Bane's mercy, and Bane demanded that Skywalker unlock the memory crystal, fully prepared to open the airlock to the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of space and send Tano to her death if he refused to do so. With his Padawan's life at risk, Skywalker handed over his [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and used the Force to disassemble the holocron, combining it with the crystal and making the crystal's contents readable. Once Bane had taken the holocron, Skywalker retrieved Tano's lightsaber and his own weapon with the Force and made quick work of Bane's super battle droid bodyguards. In retaliation, Bane opened the airlock, keeping the two Jedi occupied while he flew away with his rocket [[Boot/Legends|boots]] through an emergency bulkhead that sealed behind him. Bane made contact with Gunray and informed him of his success with gaining access to the crystal. Although Gunray offered to send an escape vessel in exchange for the transmission of the data, Bane remained too cagey to give in to his terms. With his own plans for escape, Bane made his way to a shaft overlooking the frigate's hangar bay, which was housing a firefight between the clones and droids over control of a ''Sheathipede''-class shuttle. While looking over the firefight, Bane was confronted by troopers [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] and [[Koho/Legends|Koho]]. The bounty hunter killed both Denal and Koho and stole the former's [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]], using it to pose as the clone. Bane also removed his own [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] breathing tubes in order to don the trooper's helmet. To convince Skywalker and Tano that he was Denal, the clone [[Armor/Legends|armor]]–clad Bane shot a figure garbed in his own outfit. The Jedi witnessed Bane's exploit, and as they believed him to be dead, they did not suspect that the trooper was Bane when he joined them on their shuttle and escaped the frigate with them shortly before it exploded, though Skywalker could still [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] his persona in the Force. After returning to the ''Resolute'' with the Jedi and clones, Bane disembarked the shuttle with the others and discreetly made his way away from the group, though he left green [[Blood/Legends|blood]] behind on the shuttle due to an arm injury that he had sustained.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]'' Tano followed the disguised Bane to get him to receive treatment for his injuries at the medical bay, and she eventually realized that he was not a clone. Bane responded to her voiced realizations by kneeing her in the midsection, causing her to fall to the floor. Making his way to a [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighter]], Bane took out several troopers around the fighter and boarded the ship. Skywalker jumped onto Bane's activated fighter and knocked his helmet off, revealing the true identity of the "trooper." Bane piloted his fighter out of the hangar and its [[Magnetic field/Legends|magnetic shield]], forcing Skywalker to jump off, and proceeded to the ''Resolute''{{'s}} set of [[Syliure-31 hyperspace docking ring (V-19 Torrent model)/Legends|hyperdrive rings]]. Although struggling with the starfighter due to his lack of specialist training for the vehicle, he managed to steal a [[Hyperspace transport ring/Legends|booster ring]] before the ''Resolute''{{'s}} crew could lock them down, escaping to hyperspace and evading capture by the Jedi. Bane's murder of Ropal enabled him to cash in the million-credit bounty on Jedi from the Separatists, as he had done with Ord Enisence. ====Kidnapping younglings==== {{Quote|It is only a matter of time before we locate the holocron. Make it ''easier'' on yourself.''"
"''What are you going to do, Jedi, Torture me?''"
"''I think the fear of whoever you work for outweighs your fear of us.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, Cad Bane, and Mace Windu|audio=OnlyAMatterOfTime-CotF.flac|}} Returning to Black Stall Station, Bane informed Sidious of his success with unlocking the crystal and asked if there was anything else that he could do for him. The Sith Lord gave Bane a new job: capturing four of the Force-sensitive infants listed in the crystal and delivering them to the remote planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where Sidious planned to experiment with them to build his own personal corps of Force-wielding [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. Bane agreed to do the job, provided that he continue to get his pay. Leaving the stolen holocron at his hideout, Bane used the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']], the elite ''Rogue''-class starfighter that Sidious had gifted to him,{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|pack=''Xanadu Blood''|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/The_Clone_Wars_Xanadu_Blood.asp}} to [[Mission to Glee Anselm/Legends|capture]] the young [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]] on the planet [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]]. Next traveling to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], Bane donned a Jedi robe to pose as a Jedi and avoid attracting unwanted attention in the [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|operation at hand]]. Bane met with the Rodian [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]], the mother of the Force-sensitive [[Wee Dunn/Legends|Wee Dunn]], in their home in [[Kay-Tap square/Legends|Kay-Tap square]]. Though the Rodian mother recalled Bolla Ropal's previous statement that her son would not have to start his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the Jedi Temple for some time, Bane deceived her, stating that Jedi impostors had been stealing Force-sensitive children across the galaxy—with the increased danger, he claimed that he had to take the young Dunn immediately. [[File:CadBaneKidnapper-FFtwitter.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane masqueraded as a Jedi to kidnap Wee Dunn.]] Encountering difficulties with convincing Mahtee to surrender her son to him, Bane used a [[Hypnogazer/Legends|hypnogazer]] to temporarily alter her memory and force her into complying with his demands. Preparing to escape with the young Dunn in his arms, Bane witnessed Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi—who had been dispatched to prevent the kidnapping—enter the room and learn of the child's capture from Mahtee. When Kenobi caught sight of him, Bane activated his rocket boots and soared to the platform where the ''Xanadu Blood'' was docked. Kenobi went after Bane but arrived too late to prevent him from leaving Rodia with Dunn. After delivering both Toa and Dunn to Sidious's [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|Mustafar facility]] and wiping the ''Xanadu Blood''{{'s}} [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation]] records, Bane traveled to the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|track down]] his next target—the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] infant [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|Roo-Roo Page]]. Touching down near Page's home, located in the waterfall-surrounded [[Jan-gwa city/Legends|Jan-gwa city]], Bane proceeded to Page's home and witnessed her [[Roo-Roo Page's mother/Legends|mother]] place a small figure in a crib in the nursery before leaving the room. Believing that she had left behind Page, Bane entered the nursery and pulled back the crib's blanket, only to find a [[Tooka doll/Legends|tooka doll]] in place of the expected infant. A moment later, Ahsoka Tano jumped into the room, lightsaber drawn. Remarking on the Padawan's combination of cleverness and naivety, Bane ensnared her lightsaber with his gauntlet's [[lanyard]] and yanked the weapon out of her grip. He released a barrage of blaster fire at Tano, who ducked behind some furniture to avoid the attack. With Tano briefly distracted, Bane attempted to escape out the [[Window/Legends|window]] with his rocket boots but was stopped by Skywalker, who jumped off the building's roof and grabbed onto his boots. With the extra weight, Bane's boosters were disabled, and the two tumbled onto a roof. The pair engaged in a brief struggle before landing on the ground, and the outmatched Bane looked up to see Tano's lightsaber in his face. Bane was placed in binders, and Tano retrieved her Padawan braid jewelry that he had previously taken from her at Devaron. When Tano told Page's relieved mother that her Force-sensitive daughter was safe, Bane questioned that claim before Skywalker led him away. Bane and the ''Xanadu Blood'' were taken to the ''Resolute'', where the bounty hunter was placed in a shielded holding cell aboard the Star Destroyer while the Jedi examined his starfighter. During an interrogation by Masters Kenobi and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], Bane refused to reveal the whereabouts of the kidnapped children, the location of the holocron, and the identity of his client, and the Jedi left his cell to devise another way to glean the information from him. With no alternative methods of interrogation, Windu, Kenobi, and Skywalker bound together and [[Mind trick/Legends|employed]] the Force to compel the strong-minded Bane to lead them to the stolen holocron—an act that came at the risk of destroying his mind. Thrashing from his attempts at resisting the Jedi's influence, Bane promised to take them to the holocron, albeit with the intention of leading them into a [[Mission to Black Stall Station/Legends|trap]]. [[File:BaneWinduKenobi-COTF.png|thumb|right|250px|Bane shows Kenobi and Windu around the trap-laden Black Stall Station.]] The handcuffed Bane was escorted into a waiting [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]], where he dictated Black Stall Station's coordinates to his accompanying guards—Kenobi, Windu, and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], nicknamed "Cody." After arriving in the asteroid-strewn Rogue Antar system and docking to the [[Space station/Legends|station]], Kenobi and Windu left Cody with the ship and followed Bane into his headquarters. Though neither Jedi sensed the kidnapped infants, Bane told them that the children were safe and focused on the holocron, leading them to the station's control room and directing them to the holocron on a table across the room. Although Bane volunteered to get the holocron for them, Windu refused to let him continue his tricks and proceeded to retrieve the holocron himself. However, Windu unintentionally activated the station's intruder alert system, triggering [[Klaxon/Legends|Klaxon]] alarms and a laser system that targeted the Jedi. Bane sneaked away from the distracted Jedi Masters and evaded the pursing Kenobi by escaping through a concealed hatch, bidding the Jedi farewell as he left. Breaking out of his binders, Bane departed Black Stall Station in an escape pod, triggering the station's self-destruct sequence and leaving the Jedi occupied with securing their own getaway. Despite his escape from the Jedi's custody, Bane was ultimately unable to complete his kidnappings of the infants, as Skywalker and Tano [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|foiled]] Sidious's plot shortly thereafter. ===Employment by the Hutts=== ====Plot to free Ziro the Hutt==== {{Quote|The almighty Jabba requires further assistance.''"
"''You saying there's still more moves to this dance?''"
"''Name your price.''"
"''Aww, I suppose I could rearrange my busy schedule. But I'll need details. Oh, and an advance on my services while we negotiate new terms.|TC-70, translating for Jabba Desilijic Tiure, and Cad Bane|{{TCW|Evil Plans}}}} [[File:BaneTodoHELIOS-3E.png|thumb|left|250px|Bane sends Todo 360 and HELIOS-3E after C-3PO on Coruscant.]] Following his work for Darth Sidious,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode308.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Evil Plans}} Bane retrieved the ''Xanadu Blood'' as well as Todo 360, whom Skywalker had rebuilt in an attempt to learn more about Bane and his whereabouts before the droid had escaped. Bane was soon hired by Jabba Desilijic Tiure to retrieve the plans for the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] as part of a plot to free his uncle, Ziro Desilijic Tiure, from Republic custody. After meeting with Jabba at his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on Tatooine, Bane took the ''Xanadu Blood'' to Coruscant, where he intended to capture Senator Padmé Amidala's personal [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], whom he assumed would have the plans to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] headquarters. After setting up a [[Coruscant Industrial Zone Detention Center/Legends|hideout]] in Coruscant's [[Factory District|industrial sector]], Bane proceeded with Todo 360 and the IG-86 sentinel droid [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]] to the planet's underlevels, where he found C-3PO shopping with R2-D2 for some [[Jogan fruit/Legends|jogan fruit]]. Bane had Todo separate C-3PO and R2-D2 by sending the latter to a [[Droid Spa/Legends|droid spa]], and after Todo and HELIOS-3E had delivered the captured C-3PO to him, the protocol droid was transferred to a [[ComfortRide passenger airspeeder/Legends|ComfortRide passenger airspeeder]] piloted by a [[Unidentified Nikto criminal/Legends|Nikto associate]] of Bane. The group spirited C-3PO away to their industrial sector hideout, where the droid was attached to a torture apparatus and was affixed with a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]]. When the [[8D smelter droid]] [[J0-N0/Legends|J0-N0]] forcefully delved into C-3PO's [[Memory bank/Legends|memory banks]], Bane found that his prisoner was devoid of the plans to the Executive Building or any other information useful to him. Despite that setback, Bane realized while conferring with C-3PO that R2-D2, as an astromech droid, would likely hold the plans to the Executive Building, and he thus sent Todo and HELIOS-3E after R2-D2. Bane continued to have J0-N0 electrocute C-3PO, who at one point mistook Bane for Skywalker and recalled his previous service to the chief negotiator of the [[Manakron system/Legends|Manakron system]]. After HELIOS-3E brought R2-D2 back to Bane, the astromech droid took C-3PO's place on the torture apparatus and was also fixed with a restraining bolt. Before J0-N0 accessed R2-D2's memory banks, Bane threatened the astromech droid, ordering him to surrender the plans to the Executive Building. The droid did so, and Bane immediately had J0-N0 download the data to a [[Datapad/Legends|memory drive]]. While Bane returned to Tatooine to deliver the information to Jabba the Hutt, he had Todo and HELIOS-3E dump C-3PO and R2-D2 back at the street where they had found them; Todo and HELIOS-3E only had to remove the droids' restraining bolts to [[Memory wipe/Legends|wipe their memory]] of the incident. After landing the ''Xanadu Blood'' at Jabba's Palace, Bane proceeded to the complex's throne room and met with Jabba, to whom he delivered the Senate's floor plans on a datapad. While collecting his pay—a large case laden with [[Credit ingot/Legends|Republic credit ingots]]—from Jabba's protocol droid translator, [[TC-70/Legends|TC-70]], Bane learned that Jabba required him for further assistance, as his successful acquisition of the Senate's floor plans had proven his worth to Jabba.''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' Conferring directly with Jabba, Bane requested details for the new assignment and an advance fee for his services while new terms were negotiated. Jabba revealed that he required the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council's]] approval for the potential venture, leading Bane to recognize that the job held a significant amount of weight. Dismissing everyone from the throne room save for Bane, Jabba opened communications with the other heads of the five Hutt families that comprised the Hutt Council—including the Hutts [[Arok/Legends|Arok]], [[Oruba/Legends|Oruba]], [[Marlo/Legends|Marlo]], and [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo]]{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode309.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Hunt for Ziro}}—and began to discuss the matter of freeing Ziro the Hutt, who had been [[Raid on Ziro the Hutt's Coruscant club|arrested]] earlier in the war for crimes against both the Republic and Jabba himself.[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] As his ancient [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] was rather rusty, Bane had TC-70 translate the Hutts' deliberations for him. Through TC-70, Bane learned that the Hutt leaders sought to take Ziro in under their "protection" because he possessed and had hidden a [[Hutt Council records/Legends|record]] of all the Hutt families' criminal dealings. When Oruba inquired as to who would be undertaking the dangerous task of liberating Ziro, Bane took that as his cue to make his entrance and introduced himself to the Hutts, who hired him for the job.{{DB|character|cadbane|Bane, Cad}} [[File:BaneHutts.png|thumb|right|250px|Bane introduces himself to the leaders of the Hutt Council, his new employers.]] Instead of mounting a straightforward prison break to free Ziro from the high-security{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/evil_plans_preview/index.html|text=C-3PO and R2-D2 Get An Adventure of Their Own}} Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center on Coruscant, where he had been incarcerated, Bane was to use the stolen plans for the Republic Executive Building{{SW|url=video/evil-plans-episode-featurette|text="Evil Plans" Episode Featurette}} to organize a raid on the Senate and take senators as hostages to force the Republic into freeing Ziro.
